systemRequirements: Apple Silicon Mac for the arm64 build
Intel Mac for the x64 build
Outbound HTTPS access to the NSN Librarian web app
privacySummary: The Bridge works only with folders Deanne explicitly chooses.
Watching is read-only until Deanne approves an Organization Plan and types EXECUTE.
NSN does not upload Deanne's full local library.
Disconnecting a folder does not delete local files.
Folder access can be revoked at any time.
releaseNotes: Production Bridge architecture for macOS pairing, folder selection, command polling, and safe execution authorization.
Installer assets are published through GitHub Releases, not committed into the repository.
Unsigned development builds must be labeled before testing.
